setup: Stand side-on on a low step or box
Other foot hanging off the side
execution: Lower until the free heel just taps
Keep your weight on the step leg
Stand back up through that foot
faults: Don't drop the last few centimetres
Don't let the standing knee cave in
Don't push off the floor with the free foot
Don't let your hips tip sideways

notes: Start on a low, stable step and raise the height only when the lowering stays slow and the knee stays in line.
Stand near a rack or wall you can touch for balance if needed.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain at the knee that builds during the set
Pain that changes how you move

regressions.name: Lower step
regressions.reason: Less depth, so less knee bend under load.

regressions.name: Step-down with a hand on support
regressions.reason: Takes balance out so you can focus on control.

progressions.name: Higher step
progressions.reason: More depth on the standing leg.

progressions.name: Forward step-down
progressions.reason: Free foot reaches forward; a different, often harder, knee position.

progressions.name: Step-down holding dumbbells
progressions.reason: Adds load once control is solid.

substitutions.name: Dumbbell step-up
substitutions.reason: Same box, driving up instead of lowering down.

substitutions.name: Split squat
substitutions.reason: Single-leg knee bend with both feet on the floor.

guideBrief.cameraNote: Front view at knee height so the standing knee's line over the foot and the level of the hips are clear. Figure faces the camera on a low step, free leg hanging off the side of the step.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Standing tall on the step on one leg, standing knee straight but not locked. Free leg hanging beside the step, foot just off the edge. Hips level, hands on hips or out for balance.

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Standing knee bent, tracking over the second toe. Free heel lightly touching the floor beside the step, no weight on it. Hips level, slight forward lean.

ikHints: Standing foot flat on the step throughout
Free heel touches the floor only at the bottom
emphasise: Standing knee in line with the foot
doNotShow: Hip dropping on the free side
Weight shifting onto the free foot
